title: CPU download-mode Pod is pinned to one CPU flavor - a cpu3c stock-out in EU-RO-1 blocks Connect outright
description: _createPodInternal hardcodes spec.cpuFlavorIds = ['cpu3c'] for the no-GPU download-mode Pod (MPI-88), so a single flavor going out of stock in the volume's data center refuses Connect with RunPod's 'There are no longer any instances available with the requested specifications'. Live 2026-08-31 in EU-RO-1: the identical spec created fine on 2026-07-29/30 (podId 5guftel67o99u4, omi9588i0gymlu) and git diff since that commit touches zero CPU-branch lines, so this is pure supply, not drift. The reconnect path compounds it - _isGpuAvailable is skipped for CPU on the stated assumption that 'CPU capacity is effectively always available', which this refusal disproves. Fix: hand RunPod the whole flavor list and let it place on whatever is free.
